user_problem: Teams do not know who must review an artifact or in what sequence approvals should occur.
unique_output: A role-based approval path with entry criteria, decision rights, escalation points, and evidence required at each handoff.
test_case: Given four roles and two conditional approvals, produce the path and flag an approval loop.
overlap_to_check: Scope-change briefs, handover checks, and meeting workflows.
specific_guardrail: Only supplied authority rules; explicitly detect ambiguous/cyclic paths without inventing approving roles or granting approval.
